Build a Reusable Control Reference Profile

Source: R/module_scoring.R
BuildReferenceProfile.Rd

Summarizes a set of control samples into per-probe median beta values. The result can be passed as reference_beta to AnalyzeImprintStatus() or runImprintome(), so that one tissue-matched control set (for example public normal samples) can centre cohorts that have no controls of their own. Save it with saveRDS() to reuse it across studies.

Usage

BuildReferenceProfile(
  beta,
  samples = NULL,
  probeset = NULL,
  genome = "hg38",
  normalization = NULL
)

Arguments

beta

Probe-by-sample beta matrix, data frame, file path, a MethQcSet (EPICv2 data must be aggregated first with aggregate_probes()), or an ImprintomeSet.

samples

Optional character vector of control sample names; NULL uses all samples.

probeset

Optional probeset name. The profile is limited to its probes. NULL (default) keeps every probe of every probe-level panel of genome, so one profile serves all panels.

genome

Genome build of the probeset annotation, "hg19" or "hg38" (default "hg38"). Ignored when beta is an ImprintomeSet, whose own genome is used.

normalization

Beta normalization of the control data, for example "noob" (see runMethQC()). Taken from qc_params(beta)$normalization when beta is a MethQcSet and this argument is NULL. It is recorded in the profile and reported in the reference column of scoring results, so that a profile can be matched to cohorts preprocessed the same way.

Value

Named numeric vector of per-probe median beta values, with attributes n_samples, genome, probeset, and normalization ("unspecified" when unknown).
